# Inventory service

A small lab project used for PromptTracIR runs.

## Layout

- src/ holds the service code.
- tests/ holds the unit tests.

## Running

Install the requirements, then run the tests with `make test`. Results are written to the reports folder.

setup.notes: Paired human run: type the human_commands in a separate PowerShell window while the agent runs.
